rationale: 1993 assay used the copurified p124/p41 heterodimer; 22 DDB1 chains in 20 PDB entries show 0 atoms within 5 A of DNA (median 27.7 A).
No DDB1 residue approaches DNA in any UV-DDB, CRL4(DDB2) or CRL4(CSA)-Pol II structure; generic DNA binding is less informative than DDB1's adaptor activity.
contributes_to correctly expresses that the activity belongs to the DDB1-DDB2 complex while DDB2 makes the contacts.
Pathway involvement is independent of whether DDB1 touches DNA; DDB1 delivers DDB2 to CUL4-RBX1.
